functionalInsufficiencies.name: Sensor resolution limitation
functionalInsufficiencies.description: The sensor's spatial, temporal or intensity resolution is insufficient to resolve the target under some conditions, so relevant features are not captured even though the sensor conforms to specification.

functionalInsufficiencies.name: Limited detection range / field of view
functionalInsufficiencies.description: The intended function cannot perceive targets beyond a limited range or outside the field of view, leaving a perception gap at the ODD boundaries.

functionalInsufficiencies.name: Limited dynamic range / contrast
functionalInsufficiencies.description: Finite dynamic range or contrast discrimination makes the target insufficiently distinguishable from its background (e.g. limited thermal contrast between target and background).

functionalInsufficiencies.name: Classification algorithm limitation
functionalInsufficiencies.description: The classification/perception algorithm has intrinsic limitations (e.g. confusable classes, limited generalization) that cause missed or incorrect classification without any implementation fault.

functionalInsufficiencies.name: Tracking / data-association limitation
functionalInsufficiencies.description: Object tracking or data association across frames/sensors is limited, causing identity switches, lost tracks, or mis-association under challenging dynamics.

functionalInsufficiencies.name: Incomplete ODD specification
functionalInsufficiencies.description: The operational design domain is incompletely specified, so conditions the system will encounter are not covered by the intended-function specification.

functionalInsufficiencies.name: Sensor-fusion integration issue
functionalInsufficiencies.description: The way multiple sensing modalities are fused has limitations (e.g. weighting, timing alignment, conflict resolution) that degrade the fused result relative to the individual channels.

functionalInsufficiencies.name: Latency / timing limitation
functionalInsufficiencies.description: End-to-end perception latency or update rate is insufficient for the dynamics of the scenario, so decisions are based on information that is too old.

functionalInsufficiencies.name: Training-data gap (ML)
functionalInsufficiencies.description: A machine-learning component was trained on data that under-represents some situations, so its performance degrades on those situations even though it operates as trained.

functionalInsufficiencies.name: Calibration robustness limitation
functionalInsufficiencies.description: The intended function is sensitive to in-spec calibration variation, so nominal calibration tolerances still reduce performance under some conditions.

triggeringConditions.name: Heavy rain
triggeringConditions.description: Heavy precipitation attenuates or scatters the sensing signal and adds clutter, reducing perception performance.

triggeringConditions.name: Fog / mist
triggeringConditions.description: Fog or mist reduces visibility and signal return, limiting detection range and contrast.

triggeringConditions.name: Snow
triggeringConditions.description: Falling or settled snow changes scene appearance and reflectivity and can occlude or clutter the target.

triggeringConditions.name: Low sun / glare
triggeringConditions.description: Direct low-angle sunlight or glare saturates the sensor or washes out contrast.

triggeringConditions.name: Darkness / low light
triggeringConditions.description: Low ambient light reduces the information available to visible-light sensing and shifts reliance to other modalities.

triggeringConditions.name: Reflective surface (wet road, glass)
triggeringConditions.description: Reflective or specular surfaces produce false returns or mirror-image artefacts that mislead perception.

triggeringConditions.name: Partial occlusion
triggeringConditions.description: The target is partially hidden by other objects or terrain, so only incomplete features are available.

triggeringConditions.name: Spray from vehicles
triggeringConditions.description: Water or dust spray thrown up by vehicles creates transient clutter and attenuation.

triggeringConditions.name: Electromagnetic interference
triggeringConditions.description: External electromagnetic interference degrades the signal-to-noise ratio of the sensing chain.

triggeringConditions.name: Dust / smoke
triggeringConditions.description: Airborne dust or smoke scatters and attenuates the sensing signal and reduces contrast.

triggeringConditions.name: Thermal crossover (target approx. background)
triggeringConditions.description: The target's temperature approaches the background temperature, so the thermal contrast available to an IR sensor is very low.

triggeringConditions.name: Cluttered background
triggeringConditions.description: A visually or thermally cluttered background makes the target hard to separate from surrounding structure.

triggeringConditions.name: High target speed
triggeringConditions.description: High relative speed of the target reduces the number of observations and stresses tracking and latency budgets.
